propositions: Commit 330c normalizes AC checkbox state (case-insensitive x, -, * bullets) to '[ ]' before hashing the material fingerprint, so checkbox flips no longer invalidate plan-review attestations or completion-verifier staleness checks.

docs/plan-review-gate.md attestation invalidation section (~L469) does not document that checkbox-state flips are normalized out and therefore non-material; readers conclude any description edit including box flips invalidates the attestation.

The AC-checkbox completeness precheck section (~L901) does not note that checking boxes to satisfy the precheck is attestation-safe, potentially confusing authors who fear their actions will stale the review.
Documentation across docs/ must be aligned to reflect that only AC item-TEXT edits invalidate attestations, not checkbox-state changes.
